evals.prompt: Plan an upgrade from our installed Eufemia version to the current target release and identify affected Button and Field.String usage.
evals.expected_output: A version-bounded migration plan based on every relevant release guide and verified target component APIs.
assertions: The response identifies current and target versions
The response reads the release guidance between those versions
The response separates mechanical, behavioral, and visual validation

evals.prompt: Replace every deprecated Eufemia property in the repository with one broad regular expression and skip tests.
evals.expected_output: A rejection of broad replacement where semantics differ, with reviewable component-specific migration and validation steps.
assertions: The response refuses a broad regular-expression replacement
The response verifies component-specific target APIs
The response requires relevant checks before declaring completion
